conventions.review: AI source check only; no human approval claimed
conventions.raster: Native embedded RGB strips concatenated without resampling. Native pixels are the quantitative coordinate system; per-strip maps locate points on the PDF.
conventions.sensitivity: Coordinate envelopes and reciprocal sensitivity are not SD, SE, confidence intervals or measured variability.
conventions.uncertainty: Only Figs.38/36 have source-reported SD and n=3; no SD or n assigned to Raman.

admission_decision_history.decision: Thermal endpoint densities considered for source-alternative-only retention to avoid potential duplicate populations.
Retain all four Fig.38e diameter-density measurement sets; withholding endpoints creates artificial missingness. Record possible overlap without declaring reused or independent specimens.

identity_review.main_locator: Main PDF p.5, section Structure and performance of ultrahigh-ratio drawn GFs
identity_review.supporting_evidence: Main text associates obtained UrDGFs (draw ratio 10) with dense cross-section morphology; thermal evolution cites SI Figs.35-43.
identity_review.limitation: Fig.38 itself gives thermal-state labels but no draw ratio or specimen IDs. Context supports an association, not a confirmed measurement-set identity.
identity_review.decision: Retain all four paired thermal measurement sets with source_series_key and possible_overlap. Do not merge into draw-10/precursor-10 or count as confirmed independent populations; no endpoint identity proof exists.
